# DSH Client artifacts

These six archives are generated by the DSH migration branch. `manifest.json` records the exact source commit and SHA-256 of each archive. The application installs all archives as file dependencies; `package-lock.json` pins their npm integrity and external dependencies. Upstream license files remain inside the archives.

The standalone `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client` package contains the existing generated APIs and shared Conversation and Chat runtimes with one compiled declaration graph. Shared dependencies and module augmentations retain one identity; install this application distribution without the API-only package. DSH owns its API and packaging. This directory contains no editable DSH implementation or wire schema.

To update, run `pnpm run pack:portable-client --application --out <new directory outside the checkout>` in a clean, committed DSH build checkout. Copy the six archives and manifest together, then run `npm install --package-lock-only --workspace=@getpaseo/app ./vendor/dsh/*.tgz` here and install the full workspace with `npm install` before running `npm run verify:dsh-client`. A lock-only refresh preserves the installed workspace tree; an app-only reinstallation can prune other workspace tooling. Passing the archives explicitly refreshes npm integrity even when package versions and filenames are unchanged. Review the source revision, lockfile and generated interface compatibility together. Do not hand-edit archives or their manifest.

Application dependency builds run the verification command. Native Session behavior, secure enrollment and physical iPhone acceptance require their own integration evidence; archive verification alone does not establish them.
